subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) We can't ensure peace (i) working for human and prosperity rights (b) Right should be (ii) without establishing preserved for both human rights (c) Human rights are violated (iii) for the betterment of throughout the world humanity (d) Violation of human (iv) the privileged and the rights is a crime underprivileged classes of people (e) Human Rights commission (v) and society should get is an organization rid of it (vi) should not be left unchecked (vii) because of violence and terrorism
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (ii) We cannot ensure peace and prosperity without establishing human rights. (b) + (iv) Right should be preserved for both the privileged and the underprivileged classes of people. (c) + (vii) Human rights are violated throughout the world because of violence and terrorism. (d) + (v) Violation of human right is a crime and society should get rid of it. (e) + (i) Human rights commission is an organizagion working for human rights.
